Results arrive in Phase 9. Until then there is nothing to report, and this page does not guess.

What it holds for now is the list of questions the evaluation will answer. Each one needs a number from a recorded run before the README can claim an answer. Every result file will record the config hash, the model id, the git sha and the seed. The [result tables in the plan](plan.qmd#results-table-templates-filled-only-from-result-files) stay empty until a result file fills them.

The method, the task sets, the run matrix and the formulas are in [section 8 of the plan](plan.qmd#evaluation-and-proof-plan).
